Eli: Quick note 1: I kicked off a 64k long-context bring-up for Horizon-30B quant4x with our new rotary-scaling. Seeing weird repeats after ~13k tokens.
Nora: Can you paste the minimal repro command?
Eli: ./ci/run_longctx.sh --model=horizon-30b --quant=4x --rotary=scaled --ctx=65536 --seed=123
Pavel: What "weird repeats" exactly? sample output?
Eli: snippet from stdout: "... token(13012): \u201cand the guide\u201d ... token(13013): \u201cand the guide\u201d ..." repeat never present in fp16 baseline.
Eli: Added logging: KV_LOOKUP shard=2 pos=13013 raw_idx=13013 ring_idx=32797 resolved_idx=129, then later ring_idx wraps to 29 and reads same resolved_idx.
Nora: 32797 - that's just above 32768 boundary. Are we accidentally using uint16 for ring_idx anywhere?
Pavel: Our quantjit code path uses uint16 for the perf-critical ring index on some kernels (A100/Tesla tuned). I thought we had guards for ctx>32k but maybe not for the scaled-rotary variant.
ops-bot: deploy-check: rolling-canary status for quantjit kernel: last passing version v2.4.8, current pending v2.5.1 (performance tweaks).
Eli: Reproduced locally with smaller harness: ctx=40k still shows aliasing at around 13k. FP32 and quant4x-classic are fine. Only quant4x+scaled-rotary fails.
Nora: Hypothesis: scaled rotary applies an interpolation that alters phase accumulation frequency; tiny fp truncation + 16-bit index wrap -> alias at boundary.
Pavel: Quick experiment: change ring_idx type to uint32 in the JITed kernel and rerun smoke. I'll patch locally.
Eli: While you do that, please try forcing ROTARY_SCALE=1.0 (disable scaling) as a short guard. That removes the bug in my runs.
Pavel: local patch compiled. Smoke: quant4x+scaled passes for ctx=65536, no repeats in 100k tokens sample. Perf: ~3% lower throughput on microbench.
Nora: Good. Action items: (1) Pavel to PR the uint32 fix with perf notes, (2) temporary router guard to prevent quant4x+scaled for ctx>32k (Nora), (3) add a fuzz unit that flips ring index widths and feeds long prefixes (Eli).
Eli: Filed issue #ML-4387 with logs and small reproducible seed. Also uploaded kv dump: https://gist.github.com/redwood/hz-kv-dump-1798881234
eval-bot: queued eval run eval-2044 (Eli) - longstory_20k quant4x scaled-rotary ctx=65536; artifacts s3://redwood-evals/eli/2044/
ops-bot: note - alert created if quantjit v2.5.1 rolls to prod before ML-4387 fixed.
Pavel: Opening PR now. Will include microbench script to show perf delta and a quick unit toggling index width.
Nora: Also add a note to the Optimize docs: "avoid quant4x + rotary-scaling for >32k until kernel patch lands". I'll draft copy.
Eli: Thanks all. Once PR merges we'll run the full long-context regression matrix and publish perf delta to the eng-ml channel.
